arStrings.szText: While you have {c_important}{u}Crackling Energy{/u}{/c} charges, you deal {c_number}[{SF_0} * 100|x%|]{/c} increased damage. When you reach full charges, your {c_important}{u}Crackling Energy{/u}{/c} damage is increased by {c_number}[SF_1]{/c} times this amount until you run out of charges.
